# Luma

> Luma is a self-hosted, MIT-licensed recreation of the Humane Ai Pin's cloud,
> control center, and device runtime, for owners who run it on their own server
> after the original service was discontinued on 28 February 2025. It is an
> independent community project, not affiliated with Humane or HP, and contains
> no Humane source code or binaries.

Luma has three parts: Cosmos (the Rust cloud the Pin calls), Center (the Next.js
web control panel), and the Pin companion apps and runtime. Read the README for
the overview and quick start, AGENTS.md for the contributor and agent rules, and
the docs below for depth. Names from the original system (the `humane.*` gRPC
packages, Android package IDs) appear only as interoperability identifiers.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, and the documentation map
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): contributor and AI-agent rules, architecture, commands
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): set up a checkout and open a pull request
